$comment: Boundary fixtures for PPN 2022-2025 migration (Task 6). Every expectation encodes a verified primary-source fact: UU 7/2021 HPP Article 4 amending UU PPN Article 7(1)(a)/(b): 10% through 2022-03-31; 11% from 2022-04-01; nominal 12% from 2025-01-01. UU PPN Article 7(2): qualifying exports 0%. PMK 131/2024 Article 2 luxury BKP -> full base 12%. PMK 131/2024 Article 3 non-luxury domestic/import/JKP/foreign utilization -> DPP nilai lain 11/12 (effective 11% = 12% × 11/12). PMK 131/2024 Article 5 luxury-BKP domestic retail final consumer -> 11/12 through 31 Jan 2025, full base from 1 Feb 2025. PMK 131/2024 Article 4 carve-out for special schemes (PMK 11/2025 effective 4 Feb 2025; PMK 53/2025 from 1 Aug 2025). The model distinguishes nominal rate (Article 7) from DPP factor (PMK 131/11) from effective burden. Rates stored as decimal fractions (0.10 = 10%). Amounts are 2-decimal currency strings in IDR. See data/v2/sources.json for primary locators.

effectiveDate.$comment: UU HPP 7/2021 Article 4 amends UU PPN Article 7(1)(a)/(b). The 11% nominal rate started 2022-04-01 (NOT 2022-01-01). The 12% nominal rate started 2025-01-01 per UU HPP.

concepts.$comment: Distinct concepts for nominal rate (Article 7), DPP factor (PMK 131), and conditional 2025 candidates. Export 0% is its own concept, distinct from exempt/non-object.

boundaries.description: UU HPP Article 4 / UU PPN 7(1)(a): through 2022-03-31 the nominal rate is 10%. Boundary day must resolve 10%, NOT 11%.
UU HPP Article 4 / UU PPN 7(1)(a): from 2022-04-01 the nominal rate is 11%. Boundary day must resolve 11%, NOT 10%.
Through 2024-12-31 the nominal rate under UU PPN 7(1)(a) HPP is still 11%. The 12% nominal rate does NOT arrive before 2025-01-01.

PMK 131/2024 Article 3: non-luxury BKP domestic supply in 2025 -> DPP nilai lain 11/12 of actual price; effective burden = 12% × 11/12 = 11%. The substantive 2025 burden remains 11% for the non-luxury case.
PMK 131/2024 Article 2: luxury BKP subject to PPnBM -> full-base 12% on domestic supply from 2025-01-01.
PMK 131/2024 Article 5: domestic luxury-BKP supply to a final consumer by an entitled retail PKP in January 2025 uses 11/12 DPP (effective 11%).
PMK 131/2024 Article 5: from 2025-02-01 the luxury-BKP retail final-consumer supply moves to the full base (12%).
PMK 131/2024 Article 3: non-luxury BKP import -> DPP 11/12, effective 11%.
PMK 131/2024 Article 2: luxury BKP import -> full base 12%.
UU PPN Article 7(2): qualifying exports of tangible/intangible BKP and JKP are 0% throughout. Distinct concept from exempt/non-object.
PMK 131/2024 Article 3: foreign intangible/JKP utilization -> DPP 11/12, effective 11%.

In 2025 the luxury-BKP classification determines whether the full-base 12% or the 11/12 DPP applies. Without the luxuryBkp fact the resolver must return conditional candidates (bersyarat or fakta_kurang), never a single universal number.

dppFactor.$comment: PMK 131/2024 Article 3 DPP nilai lain factor for non-luxury transactions: 11/12 of the actual price. Stored as information_factor in the rule so the effective burden (12% × 11/12 = 11%) is computable without storing '11%' as the only substantive 2025 rate. 11/12 ≈ 0.9166667 (kept to 7 decimals; the canonical factor is the exact rational 11/12).

year2025ConditionalCandidates.$comment: Year 2025 must return conditional candidates, not one misleading universal number. A year query in 2025 should yield multiple segments covering the 11/12 DPP (effective 11%) regime and the full-base 12% regime side by side, with the determination surfacing the conditional nature.
